# META
~~~ini
description=Tag unions and pattern matching
type=dev_object
~~~
# SOURCE
## app.roc
~~~roc
app [main] { pf: platform "./platform.roc" }

Color : [Red, Green, Blue]

to_str : Color -> Str
to_str = |color|
    match color {
        Red => "red"
        Green => "green"
        Blue => "blue"
    }

main = to_str(Red)
~~~
## platform.roc
~~~roc
platform ""
    requires {} { main : Str }
    exposes []
    packages {}
    provides { "roc_main": main_for_host }
    targets: {
        inputs_dir: "targets/",
        x64glibc: { inputs: [app] },
    }

main_for_host : Str
main_for_host = main
~~~
# MONO
~~~roc
# platform
main_for_host = <required>

# app
to_str = |color| match color {
	Red => "red"
	Green => "green"
	Blue => "blue"
}
main = to_str(Red)

~~~
